$comment: PRD §8.5 rule-based fallback (FR-3.5). Lookup: exact equipmentTag first, then generic pattern rules evaluated against data-derived facts (detector signal roles/directions, equipment type, monitored parameters, incident mechanism). Exact rules are DISABLED in leave-one-out mode because they contain the verified answer. Extend by adding entries — no code change needed.

exact.rootCause: Premature mechanical seal failure from intermittent dry-running: suction cavitation + seal-flush flow below 6 L/min, no protection interlock

action.title: Install seal-flush flow switch with DCS alarm; add low-NPSH / loss-of-flush trip interlock
action.description: Install a seal-flush flow switch with DCS alarm on PU-2101B and add a low-NPSH / loss-of-flush trip interlock so the seal is protected from dry-running during feed swings.

exact.rootCause: Journal-bearing babbitt distress from water ingress via leaking lube-oil cooler tube; no online water-in-oil monitoring

action.title: Repair/plug lube-oil cooler tube and retest; install online water-in-oil sensor; tighten vibration alert to 45 µm
action.description: Maintenance (Static) STA-02 repairs/plugs and retests the lube-oil cooler; Reliability REL-05 installs an online water-in-oil sensor and tightens the vibration alert to 45 µm.

dataGaps: Lube-oil water content at hourly resolution

exact.rootCause: Motor DE bearing failure from grease degradation — fixed 12-month re-lube interval, no bearing-temperature trending

action.title: Move to risk-based 4-monthly re-greasing; add bearing-temp trending/alert in CMMS
action.description: Replace the fixed 12-month re-lube interval with risk-based 4-monthly re-greasing and add bearing-temperature trending with an alert in CMMS.

exact.rootCause: Tube-side coke/polymer fouling from high feed heavy-ends; no dP-based cleaning trigger

action.title: Add dP-based cleaning trigger and alarm; tighten feed heavy-ends control & filtration
action.description: Add a tube-side dP-based cleaning trigger and alarm, and tighten feed heavy-ends control and filtration.

exact.rootCause: Coupling misalignment with soft-foot and over-aged elastomer element; no alignment check in PM

action.title: Add 6-monthly laser alignment & soft-foot check to PM; track coupling-element life (12 mo)
action.description: Add a 6-monthly laser alignment and soft-foot check to the PM plan and track coupling-element life (12 months).

dataGaps: Alignment / coupling offset at hourly resolution

generic.pattern: Vibration ↑ on rotating equipment, bearing temp normal
generic.rootCause: Developing misalignment or looseness (check 2X harmonic, soft-foot, coupling)

action.title: Laser alignment + soft-foot check within 72 h
action.description: Perform laser shaft alignment and a soft-foot check within 72 h; inspect the coupling element and check the vibration spectrum for a 2X component.

generic.pattern: Bearing/winding temperature ramps, vibration flat, motor-driven

action.title: Inspect grease condition, shorten re-lube interval, add temperature trending
action.description: Inspect bearing grease condition, shorten the re-lube interval on a risk basis, and add bearing-temperature trending with an alert.

generic.pattern: Vibration ↑ with lube-oil system on machine

action.title: Lube-oil sample (water, particles); inspect cooler integrity
action.description: Take a lube-oil sample for water and particle content and inspect lube-oil cooler integrity; trend bearing condition until resolved.

dataGaps: Lube-oil water content at hourly resolution

action.title: Review cleaning trigger; schedule cleaning
action.description: Review the cleaning trigger (dP / duty based) and schedule exchanger cleaning; check feed quality for fouling precursors.

action.title: Check flush plan, NPSH margin, feed-swing ramp rate
action.description: Check the seal-flush plan and flow, verify NPSH margin during feed swings, and review the feed-swing ramp rate.

default.rootCause: Insufficient signal to discriminate a cause — no rule pattern matched the available data

action.title: Complete the RCA with 4P / 4M+1E verification
action.description: Assign the RCA owner to complete 4P and 4M+1E verification and collect the missing condition data before choosing corrective action.

dataGaps: Condition-monitoring data for this asset (only Incident Database data is available)
